text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Crown prince Sidi Mohammed presides over an international forum on democratic transitions in the world.
- Prime Minister Abdellatif Filali holds talks with his Libyan counterpart Abdelmajid al-Gu'ud on cooperation.
- Floods damage two houses in El Jadida.
- Bad weather in Europe disturbs departure flights in Morocco.
- King Hassan receives Libyan envoy, M'Hamed Zoui.
- Casablanca court sentences a man to death for murdering his wife.
